harness_items_lease_only_when_held.name: harness_items_lease_only_when_held
harness_items_lease_only_when_held.value: "harness_items"."lease_expires" IS NULL OR "harness_items"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL

harness_items_person_has_no_lease.name: harness_items_person_has_no_lease
harness_items_person_has_no_lease.value: "harness_items"."claimant_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'person' OR "harness_items"."lease_expires" IS NULL

harness_items_issue_whole.name: harness_items_issue_whole
harness_items_issue_whole.value: ("harness_items"."issue_repo" IS NULL) = ("harness_items"."issue_number" IS NULL) AND ("harness_items"."issue_number" IS NULL) = ("harness_items"."issue_github_id" IS NULL)

role_grants_area_matches_scope.name: role_grants_area_matches_scope
role_grants_area_matches_scope.value: ("role_grants"."scope_kind" = 'org' AND "role_grants"."scope_area" IS NULL) OR ("role_grants"."scope_kind" = 'jd_area' AND "role_grants"."scope_area" IS NOT NULL AND "role_grants"."scope_area" ~ '^([0-9])0-\1[9]$')
